title: pins 1.1.0
description: The run manifest pin hashes match the verification lock for specs, runner, verifier, world, and configuration. Each difference is a hash-mismatch finding on that subject and is a test-system finding. Version 1.1.0: a subject is checked when both the manifest and the lock carry its hash. A subject the lock does not carry is not-checked with reason not-declared. A subject the manifest does not carry (and the lock does) is not-checked with reason not-recorded. A subject neither the manifest nor the lock carries is not-checked with reason not-declared, because the lock is tested first and there is nothing declared to compare with. not_checked lists every subject that was not checked, and is required. percentage is 100 times the number of checked subjects without a finding divided by the number of checked subjects, so a not-checked subject is not in the denominator. When no subject was checked the check is not applicable. Version 1.0.0, which stays valid: every request carried all five subjects, and percentage is 100 times the number of matching subjects divided by 5. A 1.0.0 result has no not_checked. The schema enforces two of the rules: a check that is not applicable lists all five subjects, and an applicable one does not. The rest are rule-level, checked by the reference rules and not by this schema: a subject is never both a finding and not checked, a subject is listed once, and the percentage equals the rule's value.
